name: Does the Denver climate affect the choice of bathroom molding materials?

mainEntity.name: Does the Denver climate affect the choice of bathroom molding materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro area, including communities like Centennial and Parker, seasonal humidity shifts between dry winters and humid summer weather or daily shower steam can cause real wood trim to expand and contract significantly. This movement frequently breaks caulk lines and creates open seams at miter joints. Choosing stable synthetic moldings like PVC prevents joint separation caused by these dramatic indoor-outdoor climate swings. Local homeowners should also ensure bathroom exhaust ventilation is operating properly to manage indoor humidity levels alongside durable trim choices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, dry Colorado winters paired with humid daily showers cause wood to shrink and expand, making stable PVC or polyurethane molding ideal to prevent split joints.
